_note: feature lines traced on the 1280-px photos (ref/list.json), read off zoomed grid panels (tools/panel.py). Keys ending _R / _L are the car's right / left. hl = head lamp dark area (C shape: eyebrow lens, the outer side, the lower "gate" lens; the inner loop runs round the body-coloured blade between them), fpaint = paint edge of the front bumper (the black lower bumper and corner intake below / outboard), cowl = the hood's rear edge at the windscreen, tl = tail lamp band, rpaint = the rear haunch paint edge against the black centre section, hump = the black engine cover's outline on the deck, belt = paint edge under the side glass. tools/trace3d.py carries them onto the body (fit/traces3d.json). c14 side_R = the dark side intake slot (behind the door, leaning back) and the carbon sill as one outline; charline_R = the black strip along the side; doorrear_R / doorfront_R = the door shut lines. Re-traced (c12): fpaint_R = the black front's outline, outer bottom corner -> the corner intake (under the lamp's outer end) -> under the body-coloured blade below the lamp -> the mouth's top edge -> the centre; plate = the number plate; hoodline_R = the hood's front shut line between the lamps' inner tips. c18 plate = the rear number plate. badge (c12, c18) = the emblem's centre.
